title: Dimensional War
next_chapter_hook: A chilling fluctuation emanates from the depths of the dimensional rift—it's the aura of the invaders' true form, tearing through the void and descending at a speed beyond comprehension.

text.content: The power of Three Realms' resonance flooded into his body like a breached flood. The fragments on the Tianji Record trembled violently, and the Yin-Yang fish patterns erupted in brilliant light around Chen Ji. 'Please rewrite our fate'—this cry still echoed through the void, but it was no longer a plea, but an empowerment. The moment Chen Ji stepped into the dimensional rift, the nothingness beneath his feet solidified, forming a bridge of light woven from the fate of the Three Realms. In the distance, four twisted figures descended from higher dimensions, without concrete form, only circles of 'irrationality' spreading outward—that was existence itself transcending three-dimensional logic.

dialogue.content: 'Three-dimensional ants, dare to tread four-dimensional territory?' The leading invader emitted a distorted laugh, its 'gaze' sweeping over Chen Ji with the casual disdain of crushing ants, 'Your struggle itself is a tribute to our descent.' Its voice came from all directions, defying any acoustic transmission law, striking directly at Chen Ji's soul.

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that smirk exceptionally dazzling amid the overwhelming light. He neither dodged nor retreated, allowing the high-dimensional pressure to wash over his entire body. Bones creaked, flesh was torn by invisible forces—yet his eyes were clearer than ever. 'Four dimensions?' he repeated softly, as if savoring something laughable, 'You can't even explain what you are, yet you dare mock three dimensions?' The Tianji Record fragments in his embrace grew warm, and the whispers of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rang out once more: 'Three-dimensional rules are constraints—but also shackles.'

dialogue.content: At the end of the light bridge, demonic mist exploded, and Ye Qing's figure emerged from the void. The demonic power surrounding her now actively surged toward Chen Ji, 'Chen Ji, I lend you my power!' Her voice carried unprecedented resolve, 'Let these self-proclaimed superiors witness what dimensional reduction truly means!' Mist and Yin-Yang power merged, crystallizing an eerie pattern on the Tianji Record's surface—the tangible manifestation of three-dimensional rules.

choice.prompt: Dimensional invaders were crushing Chen Ji's physical defenses with high-dimensional pressure, four twisted figures pressing closer step by step. At this life-and-death moment, Chen Ji must choose a response strategy:

choices.description: To clash head-on with four-dimensional pressure using Yin-Yang power, forcibly offsetting dimensional suppression with Three Realms' resonance. Extremely high risk, but if successful, it will greatly intimidate the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive Heavenly Fate and physical energy
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate four-dimensional beings, showcase the indomitable will of three-dimensional creatures
choices.risk_hint: May lead to massive Heavenly Fate loss, subsequent battles weakened

text.content: Chen Ji erupted violently, Yin-Yang power transforming into two soaring dragons clashing head-on with four-dimensional pressure. In the deafening roar, countless rifts tore through the void, and viewers across the Three Realms felt their eardrums burst—but Chen Ji had withstood the first wave, blood at the corner of his mouth yet still standing!

choices.description: Using three-dimensional rules to impose reverse meaning on four-dimensional beings, transforming their dimensional advantage into shackles. This was Chen Ji's most proficient tactic—victory through wit.
choices.visible_cost: Requires time for preparation, enemy may strike first
choices.visible_reward: Trap four-dimensional beings in three-dimensional shackles, creating fatal vulnerabilities

text.content: Chen Ji advanced instead of retreating, the Tianji Record flipping frantically in his hands. Instead of direct confrontation, he actively injected the three-dimensional rule of 'causality' into the invaders—'Since you came from four dimensions, you shall bear three-dimensional cause and effect!' As his words fell, the invaders' 'irrational' existence began to distort, every action producing predictable consequences—a shackle the high-dimensional beings feared most!

choices.description: Detonate the Tianji Record's full power, creating a dimensional vortex that devours everything, ending together with the invaders. This is the final trump card.
choices.visible_cost: Tianji Record may be completely destroyed, Chen Ji's survival uncertain
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the invaders' advance team, buying the Three Realms precious respite

text.content: A grim determination flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, the Tianji Record beginning to frantically absorb his life force and Heavenly Fate. 'Want to taste three-dimensional despair?' he laughed maniacally, 'Then together—' Before he could finish, Ye Qing's voice interrupted: 'Don't be reckless! I have a way!' Demonic mist suddenly enveloped the Tianji Record, forcibly interrupting the detonation sequence.

The invaders' "laughter" grew increasingly ear-piercing; they sensed the unruly power within Chen Ji—provocation from a lower dimension. The leader stepped forward, compressing a thousand-zhang space into a thin sheet of paper instantly. The Three Realms audience gasped: "Chen Ji—!" Yet before absolute dimensional碾压, this supposedly strategy-savvytrashdisciple slowly raised his right hand. Index and middle fingers together, pointing at his temple. He made a move no one understood: he drew a circle on the boundary of his own cognition.

dialogue.content: "You came from the Fourth Dimension, thinking you grasp higher truths." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it clearly reached every presence, "But you forgot one thing—" A scornful arc curled at the corner of his mouth, "The rules of the Third Dimension are my native home. And you outsiders, the moment you stepped into the Third Dimension, violated the iron law of 'When entering a place, follow its customs'!" Before the words faded, the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light, and the "law of causality" injected into the invaders began to run wild!

text.content: A stunning scene unfolded. Those invaders who had once been invincible, viewing Third Dimension beings as mere ants, were now "rationalized"—their distorted forms gradually solidified, every action began following the chain of causality, every attack now had a predictable trajectory. The very "uncertainty" that Fourth Dimension beings prided themselves on was transformed, under the reverse empowerment of Third Dimension rules, into the most lethal shackles. "No... this is impossible!" The leader invader let out a terrified shriek; it discovered it was being "defined"—defined as a being comprehensible to Third Dimension rules, and this very "comprehension" was itself a binding!

choice.prompt: The Third Dimension Shackles successfully bound the Fourth Dimension invaders, but their struggles continued. In this decisive moment, Chen Ji must choose how to end this battle:

choices.description: Eternally seal the invaders within the Third Dimension's prison, forcing them to struggle forever in the cycle of causality. The most thorough method, but also the most exhausting.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a sealing vessel, usable for subsequent battles against the Eye of Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands; the characters on the Tianji Record transformed into countless golden chains that shot forth, wrapping around the four distorted figures layer upon layer. "The Third Dimension's prison, specially prepared for guests who don't understand the rules." He smiled with云淡风轻ease, "Enjoy the fun of the causal cycle—forever." The golden chains tightened; the invaders' shrieks turned to desperate wails, ultimately compressed into a suspended point of light that fell into Chen Ji's palm.

choices.description: Use the power of Yin-Yang unity to completely annihilate the invaders, leaving no future troubles. The most efficient yet most violent solution.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain dimensional fragments from the invaders, usable to strengthen the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji's left hand Yin, right hand Yang; the Yin-Yang fish diagram spun wildly in his palm. "Since you're here, don't even think about leaving." He clasped his palms together; Yin-Yang power became a black-and-white intertwined sun, pressing down thunderously upon the bound invaders. Eerie screams resounded through the Three Realms, followed by absolute silence—four figures turned to nothingness within the Yin-Yang True Fire, leaving only a few shards of dimensional fragments flickering with strange light.

choices.description: Don't give the enemy a quick death, but strip away their dignity piece by piece. Let all observers witness the high-dimensional beings'狼狈 and despair.
choices.visible_reward: Greatly boost morale of the Three Realms, completely destroy the invaders' psychological defenses

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't rush to act. Instead, he leisurely collected the invaders' dimensional power, then slapped the leader across the face—that slap made of pure causal law shattered the "high-dimensional being's" dignity completely. "Weren't you all very arrogant before coming?" He tilted his head, savoring the enemy's terror, "Scream a couple more times—everyone in the Three Realms is watching." Countless sharp inhales echoed through the surrounding Void—the Three Realms had never witnessed anyone dare treat a Fourth Dimension being this way!

"Do you think this is the end?" The leader invader's voice held no more arrogance, only spite, "We are merely the vanguard... our true本体is about to descend!" Before the words finished, a soul-shuddering fluctuation pulsed from the depths of the Void—the dimensional power of something a hundred, a thousand times stronger was tearing through space. The invaders' remnants began to glow, as if transmitting some signal. "Not good!" Ye Qing's face turned ashen, "They're summoning their true form!"

text.content: The dimensional rift suddenly expanded; the balance that had barely been maintained collapsed completely at this moment. The Three Realms audience felt that power beyond comprehension—that was no longer the vanguard's minor skirmishing, but true dimensional conquerors were about to arrive. "Hahahaha!" The chain-bound invaders let out mad laughter, "You Third Dimension ants, daring to resist us! When the true form arrives, it will compress your entire world into a single sheet of paper!" Chen Ji gazed at the ever-expanding rift; a trace of gravity flashed in his eyes—but the smile at the corner of his mouth grew even deeper.

dialogue.content: "The true form descending?" Chen Ji let out a light laugh; that laughter sounded especially jarring in the tense atmosphere, "I thought you might have some new tricks, but it's the same old 'calling for backup' routine." He drew the Tianji Record from his chest; the characters on the fragment were flowing at an unprecedented speed, "Mo Xiansheng, it seems our plan must be moved up." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested within the pages, his voice carrying a rare gravity: "The true form of dimensional invaders is at least a Fifth Dimension existence... with our current strength, the odds of direct confrontation are less than thirty percent."

choice.prompt: The main body of the dimensional invaders is about to descend—this will be a life-and-death crisis surpassing all previous challenges. At this critical moment determining the fate of the Three Realms, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Preserve strength, retreat to a safe zone and reorganize. Use the newly acquired dimensional fragments and sealing container to prepare before the main body's arrival.
choices.visible_cost: May be viewed as cowardice by the Three Realms' audience
choices.visible_reward: Preserve combat strength, gain preparation time
choices.risk_hint: Will become much harder to deal with after the main body descends

text.content: Chen Ji decisively ordered a retreat, and the Three Realms Allied Forces began transferring to safe zones. At that moment, a massive hand composed of pure "irrationality" extended from the dimensional rift—the palm was so enormous it could shroud half the sky! "Ant, you dare not escape!" An ancient and majestic voice echoed from the depths of the rift. It was the main body of the dimensional invader—a projection of a five-dimensional existence.

choices.description: Pour every ounce of strength into defending the Three Realms' barrier and fight the invading main body to the death. This is the most dangerous choice, but also the one most likely to ignite the Three Realms' fighting spirit.
choices.visible_reward: Greatly boost morale of the Three Realms, may attract more reinforcements
choices.risk_hint: The gap in strength is far too vast

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned sharply, facing the sky-shrouding hand. Behind him, the Three Realms Allied Forces regrouped—Tianqing Sect, Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Xuanwu Sect... all factions united for the first time. "Think you can crush us?" Chen Ji's voice resounded through the Three Realms. "Come on! Let these high-dimensional fools see what three-dimensional backbone looks like!" The resonant power of the Three Realms erupted once more—this time, not to rewrite destiny, but to守护命运!

choices.description: Attempt to negotiate with the dimensional main body, using the sealed vanguard forces as bargaining chips to buy time. Simultaneously, secretly activate the hidden function of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Activate the hidden ability of the Tianji Record, gain a chance to turn the tables
choices.risk_hint: The main body may not fall for this

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised the light point sealing the vanguard forces, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Your vanguard is in my hands." The sky-shrouding hand paused slightly, as if assessing the situation. "We can talk." A meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "Of course, unless you want these four trapped in the causal cycle forever." From the depths of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Well done... the hidden function has been activated."

text.content: The sky-shrouding hand hovered in the void, and the dimensional main body seemed to be examining this three-dimensional being who dared to negotiate with it. After several breaths of silence, the ancient voice spoke again: "Interesting... an ant dares to negotiate with me." The massive hand slightly curled inward but did not immediately strike—it indeed had reservations about the four sealed vanguard forces. "What do you want?" The main body's voice carried a condescending sense of charity, "Three-dimensional fool, state your terms."

Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he leisurely tossed and caught the sealing light point, as if playing with some interesting toy. "Terms?" He chuckled lightly, "My terms are simple—scram back to your fourth dimension and stop messing around in the third." The moment the words fell, the Three Realms erupted in an uproar. The invader main body's aura surged violently, and the massive hand pressed down another notch. "Are you mocking me?" The majestic voice churned with boundless fury, "A mere three-dimensional ant dares to—"

dialogue.content: "Mock?" Chen Ji interrupted the main body's pressure, his yin-yang power erupting around him, forming a standoff against the sky-shrouding hand. "I am merely stating facts." He held the sealing light point before his eyes. "Do you know why I can trap them? Because your dimensional advantage means absolutely nothing under three-dimensional rules." The Tianji Record at this moment radiated unprecedented light—the hidden function just activated by Mo Xiansheng was operating, "What you call dimensional strike, today I'll show you what 'ascending dimension counterattack' truly means!"

text.content: The text on the Tianji Record began to detach from the pages, transforming into boundless golden light that surged toward the sky-shrouding hand. For the first time, the dimensional main body felt threatened—not from power suppression, but from rule erosion! "This is... the Law of Causality?!" The main body let out an incredulous roar, "How could you weaponize the Law of Causality?!" Chen Ji's smile grew more brilliant: "You brought 'possibility' from the fourth dimension, and I taught it what 'inevitability' means." Golden light wound around the massive hand, and the main body's projection began to slowly dissipate!

dialogue.content: "Despicable ant!" The dimensional main body let out an angry shriek, the massive hand struggling frantically, but the golden light wound tighter and tighter. "You think this can stop us? Dream on!" Before the words finished, more terrifying auras传来 from the depths of the rift—not one massive hand, but countless! "I told you, we are merely the vanguard forces." The main body's voice regained its arrogance. "Three-dimensional trash, prepare to greet true terror!"

text.content: The dimensional rift began to expand violently, and countless twisted figures poured out—the dimensional invaders' true army. The Three Realms' audience plunged into panic, the momentary joy of victory instantly replaced by despair. Ye Qing rushed to Chen Ji's side, her voice tinged with anxiety: "Chen Ji, if this continues—" Chen Ji raised a hand to stop her, his eyes gleaming with calculating light. "The army?" he murmured to himself, "This is far more valuable than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered in his ear: "The hidden function of the Tianji Record, 'Dimensional Marking,' has been activated... you can now mark any invader. Once marked, its position, weaknesses, and even thoughts will be under your control."

A meaningful arc curved across Chen Ji's lips as his gaze swept through the dense invading army, finally locking onto a figure standing at the very front—it seemed to be the commander of this force. "Found you." he murmured softly, his right index finger lightly pointing out. A golden light invisible to the naked eye pierced through layers of void, precisely landing on that commander. The next moment, a detailed 'Invader File' surfaced in Chen Ji's mind: weaknesses, thought patterns, even its subordinate relationship with the main body—all crystal clear. "Interesting." Chen Ji's smile deepened, "So the main body and this army are connected through chains of causality... then as long as I sever this chain—"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched the familiar smile on Chen Ji's face, her heart警报大作. "What are you scheming again?" she asked warily. Chen Ji turned to look at her, his eyes glinting with cunning light: "I was thinking, if we let these invaders know—" he deliberately paused, "—that their main body has been using them as cannon fodder to deplete the three-dimensional resistance, how would they react?" Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply: "You want to—" Chen Ji raised a finger to his lips: "Shh, let the truth speak for itself." The text on the Tianji Record began arranging in an eerie manner—a language only the dimensional invaders could understand, conveying to them a message: one about the main body's true intentions.

text.content: The effect was immediate. The previously aggressive invading army suddenly fell into chaos, countless uncertain gazes shooting toward the depths of the rift—toward their lofty main body. "Nonsense!" the main body roared in fury, its massive hand furiously slapping the void, "This is a three-dimensional ant's scheme of sowing discord! Don't listen—" But its voice had lost its former authority among the invading army. The seed of doubt, once planted, grows wildly. Standing atop the bridge of light, Chen Ji overlooked this civil strife caused by his mere words, his smirk growing increasingly triumphant: "What does it matter if a high-dimensional existence? Where there's conflict of interest, there's an opportunity to exploit."

The Three Realms witnessed this inconceivable scene—the domineering dimensional invaders, thrown into chaos by just a few words from Chen Ji. The seemingly unbreakable subordinate relationship between the vanguard forces and the main body was crumbling under the erosion of causal law. "Chen Ji—!" the main body let out a near-mad howl, "I will tear you to pieces!" The sky-shading giant hand pressed down again, this time without any restraint—a full-force strike from a fifth-dimensional existence, capable of compressing ten thousand li into a two-dimensional sheet! Yet Chen Ji still did not dodge, instead spreading his arms wide to welcome that giant hand: "Come! Let all Three Realms see—who is the real ant!" Yin-Yang power and the Tianji Record's radiance intertwined behind him into a shocking scroll. The instant the giant hand touched him, the power resonant across all Three Realms erupted violently—the dimensional rift began to shrink, the invading army scattered in retreat, and that sky-shading giant hand was forcibly pushed back into the rift!

dialogue.content: "No... this is impossible!" the main body let out an incredulous shriek, "A mere three-dimensional—" Before it could finish, the rift closed completely. The invading army crumbled, scattering in all directions. Jubilation erupted throughout the Three Realms, yet Chen Ji, at this moment of victory, slowly closed his eyes. On the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed: "Well done... but this is only the beginning. The main body being forced back doesn't mean it will let this go." Chen Ji opened his eyes, gazing at that healed void, a meaningful arc curving his lips: "I know... but at least now, the Three Realms know one thing." Ye Qing walked to his side, softly asking: "What?" Chen Ji turned to look at her, his smile carrying unprecedented confidence: "Dimensional invaders... can also be afraid."
